risk_if_not_implemented: Without Explicitly Allow / Deny Applications, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may operate with insecure, unauthorized or drifted configurations that expand the attack surface. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Restrict Roles Permitted To Install Software
compensating_control_1.description: Automated mechanisms exist to prevent the installation of software, unless the action is performed by a privileged user or service.
compensating_control_1.justification: Restrict Roles Permitted To Install Software (CFG-12) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Explicitly Allow / Deny Applications (CFG-14.1) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Least Functionality
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to configure Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services.
compensating_control_2.justification: Least Functionality (CFG-03) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Explicitly Allow / Deny Applications (CFG-14.1) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
